title: Active Feature Acquisition by Distilling an Oracle Teacher
abstract: arXiv:2611.26598v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Acquiring every feature of an instance is often costly: a measurement can carry a monetary price, a time delay, or a privacy cost. Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) addresses this by learning a policy that decides, per instance, which features to acquire under a budget. Existing AFA methods train this policy by optimizing a self-constructed utility target rather than distilling an explicit teacher. We construct this teacher explicitly. At training time the label and the unobserved feature values are available, and together they determine the teacher in closed form: an oracle that ranks every candidate by its effect on the downstream predictor's error. OracleImitator distills this ranking into a deployable policy by soft-target imitation. Across multimodal medical diagnosis and the AFABench benchmark, OracleImitator matches or outperforms existing AFA methods across the budget range, recovering 90% of the attainable accuracy gain at unde

translated_title: 通过蒸馏神谕教师实现主动特征获取
translated_abstract: 获取一个实例的每一个特征往往代价高昂：一次测量可能带来金钱成本、时间延迟或隐私代价。主动特征获取通过学习一个策略来解决这一问题，该策略在预算约束下针对每个实例决定获取哪些特征。现有的AFA方法通过优化一个自行构建的效用目标来训练该策略，而不是蒸馏一个显式的教师。我们显式地构建了这个教师。在训练阶段，标签和未观测的特征值是可获得的，二者共同以闭式形式确定了这个教师：一个神谕，它根据每个候选特征对下游预测器误差的影响来对其进行排序。OracleImitator通过软目标模仿将这一排序蒸馏为一个可部署的策略。在多模态医疗诊断和AFABench基准上，OracleImitator在整个预算范围内匹配或超越了现有AFA方法，恢复了90%的可达准确率增益……
tldr: 该论文提出OracleImitator，首次显式构建了一个按候选特征对下游预测器误差影响进行排序的神谕教师，并通过软目标模仿将这一排序蒸馏为可部署的主动特征获取策略，在多模态医疗诊断和AFABench基准上于整个预算范围内匹配或超越现有方法，恢复约90%的可达准确率增益。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes OracleImitator, which explicitly constructs an oracle teacher that ranks candidate features by their effect on the downstream predictor's error and distills this ranking into a deployable AFA policy via soft-target imitation, matching or outperforming existing methods across the budget range on multimodal medical diagnosis and AFABench while recovering 90% of the attainable accuracy gain.
